<tool_call>
<function=generate_email_reply>
<parameter=content>
Subject: Re: Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thanks for reaching out. I appreciate you reviewing the contract carefully.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for net-30. Let me check with our finance team to see if we can accommodate a net-45 compromise, which might be a middle ground.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree it’s important to ensure it’s fair and reasonable. Let’s schedule a quick call to discuss potential adjustments that work for both parties.

Please let me know what time works best for you.

Best,
Ms. Adams
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
